messages.welcome:
⚠️ CODE RED - ALL UNITS RESPOND

Ranger, Chief Morrison here. An arsonist is terrorizing the city with 5 fires. They're sending riddles.

Your mission: Decode riddles, find fires, extinguish them before they spread.

Prove you're smarter. The city counts on you. Move out!
messages.falseAlarmMessage: You arrived quickly, but there's no fire here. The arsonist is playing games. Check your intel and try again!

quest1.title: The First Spark
quest1.riddle:
MESSAGE 001: 'Where children laugh beneath the trees, wood and leaves make perfect fuel.'

HINT: Green space.
quest1.successMessage: FIRE OUT! Park saved. Dry brush targeted. Families were nearby. One down, four to go!

quest2.title: The Red Herring
quest2.riddle:
MESSAGE 002: 'Red machines zoom everywhere, but one sits still in eastern air. Two wheels, gasoline.'

HINT: Red vehicle. Eastern side.
quest2.successMessage: CRITICAL SAVE! Fuel tank leaking. Bomb defused. This maniac knows where to strike!

quest3.title: A Burning Problem
quest3.riddle:
MESSAGE 003: 'Where waste rots and people discard. One spark in metal burns the whole block.'

HINT: Trash bin.
quest3.successMessage: DISASTER AVERTED! Dumpster packed with accelerants. Premeditated. Block saved!

quest4.title: Unlucky Number
quest4.riddle:
MESSAGE 004: 'Fifteen is cursed. Look high. Families trapped wave for aid. Tick tock!'

HINT: Building #15. Billboard.
quest4.successMessage: HERO! Apartment reached in time. Residents trapped, waving. Kitchen fire. Lives saved!

quest5.title: Race Against Time
quest5.riddle:
MESSAGE 005 - FINAL: 'Clock strikes five. City Hall burns. Every record. Grand finale. You're too late!'

HINT: Government building. Center.
quest5.successMessage: 🎖️ MISSION COMPLETE! City Hall saved with seconds left! Archives secured. Five fires, five wins. You're the hero. Chief Morrison: 'Outstanding work!'
